checks.ref:
command:branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
if [ -e "$dir" ]; then
  echo "$dir still exists - remove it: rm -r $dir"
  exit 1
fi
stray=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | sed 's/^...//' \
  | grep -v "^$dir/" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
if [ -n "$stray" ]; then
  echo "this stage removes $dir/ and nothing else, but the working copy also carries:"
  echo "$stray"
  echo "if you made these edits, undo each of them yourself and nothing else; if you did not, leave them exactly as they are."
  exit 1
fi
